rationale: The condition supplies the request-level identifiers needed to construct path classes and candidate cells and run the mapped procedure. The audit checks ordinary data instantiation; it does not separately require coverage sufficient for identification or establish causal discrimination.

if_execution.verification_or_satisfaction_method: Audit traces or joinable logs in both windows to verify that request latencies can be associated with path and build/configuration/flag identities, including checking sampling rates and version-assignment accuracy during rollout.
